title: Insights into anti-tuberculosis drug design on the scaffold of nitroimidazole derivatives using structure-based computer-aided approaches

Deazaflavin-dependent nitroreductase (Ddn) is a crucial enzyme involved in mycolic acid biosynthesis, a vital component of the cell wall in Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB)—the bacterial pathogen responsible for tuberculosis.
